summary: ASAN is an open-source data analysis and visualization project that serves as a centralized hub for any aspiring Earth System Data Detectives. This tool helps users find relevant variables for natural phenomena they wish to observe and uses a robust array of statistical methods to give users insight into whether or not a statistically significant trend exists.
details:
Our project allows data detectives to go analyse temporal trends in data of their choosing; it then presents statstical analysis for them and their analysis. Users can customise exactly what data they wish to study, or the software can ask them aout their topic of interest and guide them towards relavant data.

Our project is unique insofar as it not only creates time series graphs and analysis, but also creates stunning visualisations to showcase data trends (please do try it out!).

Tools:
Python, with FastAPI for the back-end

Typscript + React for the front-end
